gloss: memorial service; ceremony held to honor and remember the deceased

definitions.gloss: memorial service; ceremony held to honor and remember the deceased
definitions.explanation: memorial service; ceremony held to honor and remember the deceased

examples.japanese: {追悼式|ついとうしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する。
{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}のための{追悼式|ついとうしき}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A memorial service was held for the victims.

examples.japanese: {震災|しんさい}から{十年|じゅうねん}を{迎|むか}え、{各地|かくち}で{追悼式|ついとうしき}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: On the tenth anniversary of the earthquake, memorial services were held in various locations.

notes:
A formal ceremony to mourn and honor someone who has died, often held on anniversaries of a person's death or of disasters. Distinct from a funeral ({葬儀|そうぎ}), which takes place shortly after death — a {追悼式|ついとうしき} can be held at any later date.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追悼式|ついとうしき}を{行|おこな}う — to hold a memorial service
- {追悼式|ついとうしき}に{参列|さんれつ}する — to attend a memorial service
- {合同|ごうどう}{追悼式|ついとうしき} — joint memorial service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追悼|ついとう} — mourning; remembrance (the act itself, without {式|しき})
- {慰霊祭|いれいさい} — memorial rite (often for war dead or spirits)
- {法事|ほうじ} — Buddhist memorial service (family-centered, on specific anniversaries)
